default.rule: insertion = cannula toe + 2 r tan(dov) + 0.5 mm (+ 1.5 mm): the scope's whole tip face past the cannula; same aim as the layout

scope.frame: K (configs/twin/physics.yaml scope.frame): +z along the shaft toward the tip; origin on the shaft axis in the plane, normal to the shaft, of the tip face's distal-most point (the toe, at -y); tip-face normal = direction of view = +z turned dov about x toward +y; face: z = -(y + r) tan(dov)
scope.emitter_note: scale physics L0 by emitter_L0_scale to keep the flux (physics.yaml light_outlet note)
scope.closed: scope_shaft + scope_tip_face + scope_window + scope_light together form a closed solid

instruments.min_insertion_rule: cannula toe + the jaws' largest radius about the hinge axis behind the hinge (4.32 mm) + 0.5 mm: the jaws are past the cannula's tip at any opening
omitted_parts: rod (inside the clevis slot; they move with the jaw)

instruments.min_insertion_rule: cannula toe + the jaws' largest radius about the hinge axis behind the hinge (4.32 mm) + 0.5 mm: the jaws are past the cannula's tip at any opening
omitted_parts: rod (inside the clevis slot; they move with the jaw)

kinematics.instrument: S origin = jaw hinge; jaw_a body = S @ Rx(-jaw/2) (blade toward +y_S), jaw_b body = S @ Rx(+jaw/2) (toward -y_S); shaft and collar meshes are in S; jaw meshes in their own jaw frame (= S with the jaws closed, origin on the hinge axis)
kinematics.jaw_tips: forward(): hinge + jaw_length * R_D_S @ [0, +-sin(jaw/2), cos(jaw/2)] (straight jaws). The CAD tip in each jaw frame is tip_in_jaw_frame (the Maryland's has a lateral x offset that forward() does not model)
kinematics.cannula: body '<port>/cannula' (frame Q): R_D_Q = R_D_P @ Ry(yaw) @ Rx(pitch) of the tool in that port (no roll: the tool rolls inside it), origin = the port pivot (no insertion); the housing rests on the silicone
kinematics.scope: K uses the same RCM kinematics through port C (R_D_K = R_D_P(C) @ Ry @ Rx @ Rz, origin = pivot + insertion * R_D_K[:, 2]); K's origin is on the shaft axis in the plane of the tip face's toe (scope.frame), so insertion = pivot -> that point

boards.name: charuco_b
boards.frame: B = OpenCV CharucoBoard object frame: origin at the squares' top-left corner, x along the squares_x side, y along squares_y (down the printed image), z = x cross y INTO the board. The printed face is z = 0 and faces -z; the board is a 3 mm plate behind it (z 0..thickness).
boards.uv: u = (x + margin)/(W + 2 margin), v = (y + margin)/(H + 2 margin); (0, 0) = top-left of the PNG (first row), texel (i, j) centre at ((i + 0.5)/w, (j + 0.5)/h). Unprinted faces sample the margin
boards.object_points: CHARUCO_B.board().getChessboardCorners(): corner id k at (x_k, y_k, 0) in B
boards.pose_state: state.boards[].T_D_B maps B into D; T_D_B is the renderer's 'board/charuco_b' body pose
